prevention_rule: Portal navigation may simplify labels and presentation, but hub capability coverage, full-menu completeness and operating-system routes must continue to derive from canonical page and navigation registries.
regression_contract: Portal V2 required tests must prove complete hub coverage, canonical desktop navigation routing, full-menu registry coverage and operating-system route reachability before merge.

evidence.outcome: Portal V2 Tests run 36861757680 passed after restoring canonical hub capability coverage, desktop navigation items and full-menu registry coverage. Canonical learning replay uses the approved Brain portal-capability parity test.
